cues.en: You might be thinking, why are we going through all these stamps?
cues.zh: 可能會想，為什麼要做這麼多步驟？

cues.en: I've got my computer.
cues.zh: 我已經有電腦。

cues.en: Why do I have to download Mini Conda with Python and Conda and then install all these packages?
cues.zh: 為什麼還要下載附 Python 和 Conda 的 Miniconda，再安裝所有套件？

cues.en: I just want to get started coding.
cues.zh: 只想開始寫程式。

cues.en: And so you should be.
cues.zh: 確實該開始。

cues.en: It's good to hear you want to code.
cues.zh: 很高興你想寫程式。

cues.en: We'll be doing lots of that soon.
cues.zh: 馬上會做很多。

cues.en: But getting your computer and getting our computers set up with mini conda and Conda are important steps which will save a lot of time in the future.
cues.zh: 但先用 Miniconda 與 Conda 設定電腦很重要，未來能省很多時間。

cues.en: When you download Mini Conda and subsequently Conda, Conda gives you the ability to create environments.
cues.zh: 下載 Miniconda 並取得 Conda 後，就能建立環境。

cues.en: You'll hear a lot of these in different projects that you're working on.
cues.zh: 不同專案會經常聽到這個詞。

cues.en: Let me give you an example.
cues.zh: 舉個例子。

cues.en: A workflow for our Classifying Heart Disease project might involve starting with our computer and then
cues.zh: 心臟病分類專案的流程，可能先從電腦，

cues.en: creating a project folder which contains the data we're using patient records and the tools we're using for our machine learning project.
cues.zh: 建立專案資料夾，裡面放患者紀錄資料，以及機器學習工具。

cues.en: After a little bit of experience, we know there's a collection of tools we might want to use, such as pandas and map plot lib for data analysis.
cues.zh: 稍有經驗後，就知道可能要用一組工具，例如 pandas 與 Matplotlib 分析資料。

cues.en: A collection of tools or packages is called an environment.
cues.zh: 一組工具或套件，稱為環境。

cues.en: We use Conda to create the environment and then use it again to install different packages.
cues.zh: 用 Conda 建立環境，再用它安裝不同套件。

cues.en: Data science and machine learning tools to it.
cues.zh: 也就是資料科學與機器學習工具。

cues.en: Then every time we work on our project site classifying heart disease, we use the tools within our environment.
cues.zh: 每次處理像心臟病分類專案，就使用環境裡的工具。

cues.en: So let's walk through this.
cues.zh: 走一遍流程。

cues.en: You've got your computer.
cues.zh: 先有電腦。

cues.en: You want to start a new project such as working on heart disease.
cues.zh: 想建立新專案，例如心臟病研究。

cues.en: You might create just a separate folder, maybe on the desktop or something like that.
cues.zh: 可以在桌面等地方建立獨立資料夾。

cues.en: And then within that one single folder, you keep everything that you're going to use with that project in that folder, such as the data, remember, the patient records could be the data and the conda environment
cues.zh: 專案會用的一切，都放在同一資料夾，例如資料，還記得是患者紀錄，以及 Conda 環境。

cues.en: which are these are all the tools you're going to be working on to find insights on that data to try and predict heart disease.
cues.zh: 環境就是分析資料、預測心臟病時會用的所有工具。

cues.en: Conda is what you use to create this environment, install and update the tools that you need.
cues.zh: Conda 負責建立環境、安裝及更新需要的工具。

cues.en: Now, why is this?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Why is this helpful?
cues.zh: 這有什麼幫助？

cues.en: Why would we do it in this kind of way?
cues.zh: 為什麼要這樣做？

cues.en: Well, here's where it comes in handy.
cues.zh: 這時就有用了。

cues.en: Say, for example, you're working on your heart disease project since much of machine learning is experimental.
cues.zh: 例如進行心臟病專案，機器學習大多是實驗。

cues.en: You might be using a number of different tools for a single project.
cues.zh: 一個專案可能使用多種不同工具。

cues.en: Now, what if someone else wanted to start working on what you're working on with you?
cues.zh: 如果別人也想加入合作呢？

cues.en: Instead of setting up their own workbench from scratch, Conda allows you to share with them the exact
cues.zh: 不用從零建立工作臺，Conda 能讓你分享完全，

cues.en: same set of tools and packages you've been using so they can get started straight away.
cues.zh: 相同的工具和套件組合，讓對方立即開始。

cues.en: This may not seem helpful if you're working largely by yourself at the moment, but I can assure you it is one of the biggest problems when you start working on a team.
cues.zh: 目前多半獨自工作，可能不覺得有幫助，但團隊工作時，這是最大的問題之一。

cues.en: There would be days where me and my teammates, we would literally spend all day working on the same project or trying to set up or trying to work on the same project.
cues.zh: 有時我和同事整天都在嘗試設定或處理同一個專案。

cues.en: But we couldn't because we ran into dependency issues.
cues.zh: 卻因相依性問題無法開始。

cues.en: A dependency issue is a term that's used when you don't have the right package for the problem that you're working on, because this problem, this project, this classifying heart disease will be dependent
cues.zh: 相依性問題，是沒有問題所需的正確套件；因為心臟病分類專案會依賴，

cues.en: on these tools here.
cues.zh: 這些工具。

cues.en: And when we ran into dependency issues, it mean that we couldn't install some of these tools.
cues.zh: 遇到相依性問題，表示某些工具無法安裝。

cues.en: Conda helps to fix that dependency issue.
cues.zh: Conda 協助解決。

cues.en: It ensures that you can create this environment that's easily shareable and updatable that you can share with someone else.
cues.zh: 讓你建立容易分享、容易更新的環境，交給別人。

cues.en: So if you had multiple people on your team and you're all working on a similar project with similar data and similar data science and machine learning tools.
cues.zh: 如果團隊多人，處理相似資料與專案，使用類似工具，

cues.en: The reason being we do this workflow is so that you can create a project folder, and then if you had to share it with someone else's computer or someone else on your team, you could just send them the
cues.zh: 採用這種流程，就是為了建立包含一切的專案資料夾，需要與別人電腦或團隊成員分享時，直接把，

cues.en: project folder that contains the data and your conda environment and they would be able to get started straight away.
cues.zh: 含資料與 Conda 環境的資料夾交給對方，就能開始。

cues.en: Now again, if this seems like a lot and it is a lot to take in, we're going to have hands on practice
cues.zh: 如果覺得資訊很多，確實如此，但之後會親自練習，

cues.en: setting up a project folder as well as an environment for each of the hands on projects we're going to cover throughout this course.
cues.zh: 為課程各個實作專案，建立專案資料夾與環境。
